§6Diesel Generator§f

§aCompact liquid-fuel generator that burns oil byproducts for mid-game power!§f

The §bDiesel Generator§f is a single-block generator that burns liquid fuels. Despite its name, it accepts many fuels with effectiveness scaling by grade.

§6Crafting§f (Assembly Machine):
§b•§f §e1×§f Steel Shell, §e2×§f Cast Copper Plate, §e4×§f Copper Coil.

§6Operation§f:
§b•§f §e16,000mB§f internal tank, drains at §e20 mB/s§f.
§b•§f §e50 kHE§f energy buffer - fuel does NOT halt when full, so avoid waste.
§b•§f Change accepted fuel with a Fluid Identifier.

§6Fuel Efficiency§f:
§b•§f Low Grade: §e0%§f (won't accept).
§b•§f Medium Grade: §e50%§f.
§b•§f High Grade: §e75%§f.
§b•§f Aviation: §e10%§f.
§b•§f Gaseous: §e0%§f (won't accept).

§ePS:§f Don't waste your best fuels here! Diesel burns at §e75%§f efficiency, ideal for this generator. Save Gasoline, Kerosene, and Reformate for crafting. The §e50 kHE§f buffer fills fast - use a Redstone Comparator to shut it off when your battery bank is full!
